description_en: Queries the QR code authorization status of an Ant Blockchain transaction
description_zh: 查询蚂蚁区块链交易二维码授权状态
kebab_example: aliyun baas describe-ant-chain-qr-code-authorization --ant-chain-id bDXK6boZ --qr-code-type MINI_APP_BROWSER_TRANSACTION --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAntChainQRCodeAuthorization

parameters.description_en:
The type of the QR code. Valid values:

- MINI_APP_BROWSER_TRANSACTION: Alipay mini program blockchain browser.
parameters.description_zh: 二维码类型，当前可以选值为 MINI_APP_BROWSER_TRANSACTION 代表支付宝小程序区块链浏览器。
parameters.help_en:
